cl.c: Data sheet page 2: Application Instructions > Application Method / Tools
s: Shake the canister well for a minimum of 20 seconds before use.

Spray from a distance of about 20-30 cm, using a sweeping motion to get an even coverage of adhesive. For temporary low strength bonding, apply to only one surface. For high strength permanent bonding, apply adhesive to both surfaces. Allow the adhesive to become tacky before firmly pressing the surfaces together, applying even pressure along the entire bonding surface for 3 to 5 minutes. Pressing the surfaces together either while the adhesive is still wet or after it has lost its tack will result in a weak bond – the optimum time for bonding is when the adhesive is dry but still tacky. If required bonded materials may be repositioned within 1-2 minutes to ensure correct surface alignment.

cl.x: Tools and uncured overspray may be cleaned with Sika® Colma Cleaner or other suitable solvent. Once cured, residual material can only be removed mechanically.
